dn22:12.3: vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.4: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.5: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.6: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.7: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.8: saṅkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṅkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.9: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.10: mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.11: amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.12: sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ sauttaraṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.13: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.14: samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.15: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.16: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti,
dn22:12.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn22:12.18: iti ajjhattaṃ vā citte cittānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharati.
dn22:12.19: samudayadhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati.
dn22:12.20: atthi cittanti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya patissatimattāya. anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:12.21: evampi kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu citte cittānupassī viharati.
dn22:13.1: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati:
dn22:13.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu.
dn22:13.3: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu:
dn22:13.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando’ti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa kāmacchandassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa kāmacchandassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa kāmacchandassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:13.5: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ byāpādaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ byāpādo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ byāpādaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ byāpādo’ti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa byāpādassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa byāpādassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa byāpādassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:13.6: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ thinamiddha’nti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ thinamiddha’nti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa thinamiddhassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa thinamiddhassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa thinamiddhassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:13.7: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkuccaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkucca’nti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkuccaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkucca’nti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa uddhaccakukkuccassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa uddhaccakukkuccassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:13.8: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vicikicchaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ vicikicchā’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vicikicchaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ vicikicchā’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannāya vicikicchāya uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannāya vicikicchāya pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnāya vicikicchāya āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:13.9: iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati,
dn22:13.10: samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati
dn22:13.11: ‘atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya patissatimattāya. anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:13.12: evampi kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu.
dn22:14.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu.
dn22:14.2: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu:
dn22:14.4: ‘iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo,
dn22:14.5: iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo,
dn22:14.6: iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthaṅgamo,
dn22:14.7: iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo,
dn22:14.8: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti.
dn22:14.9: iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:14.10: samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:14.11: ‘atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya patissatimattāya. anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:14.12: evampi kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu.
dn22:15.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu.
dn22:15.2: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu:
dn22:15.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhuñca pajānāti, rūpe ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññojanaṃ tañca pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa saññojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa saññojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca pahīnassa saññojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:15.4: sotañca pajānāti, sadde ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññojanaṃ tañca pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa saññojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa saññojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca pahīnassa saññojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:15.5: ghānañca pajānāti, gandhe ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññojanaṃ tañca pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa saññojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa saññojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca pahīnassa saññojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:15.6: jivhañca pajānāti, rase ca pajānāti. yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saññojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa saññojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca pahīnassa saññojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:15.7: kāyañca pajānāti, phoṭṭhabbo ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññojanaṃ tañca pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa saññojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa saññojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca pahīnassa saññojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:15.8: manañca pajānāti, dhamme ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññojanaṃ tañca pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa saññojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathāca uppannassa saññojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca pahīnassa saññojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:15.9: iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:15.10: samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:15.11: atthi dhammāti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya patissatimattāya. anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:15.12: evampi kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu.
dn22:16.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu.
dn22:16.2: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu:
dn22:16.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ natthi me ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgoti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.4: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgoti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ natthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgoti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.5: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ viriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ viriyasambojjhaṅgoti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ viriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ natthi me ajjhattaṃ viriyasambojjhaṅgoti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa viriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.6: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.7: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.8: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.9: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgoti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti. yathā ca anuppannassa upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti. yathā ca uppannassa upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
dn22:16.10: iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:16.11: samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:16.12: ‘atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya patissatimattāya. anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:16.13: evampi kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu sambojjhaṅgesu.
dn22:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catūsu ariyasaccesu.
dn22:17.2: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catusu ariyasaccesu:
dn22:17.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
dn22:18.2: jāti pi dukkhā, jarāpi dukkhā, maraṇampi dukkhaṃ, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāpi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho, piyehi vippayogo dukkho, yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā pi dukkhā.
dn22:18.4: yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho,
dn22:18.7: yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko,
dn22:18.10: yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccumaraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷebarassa nikkhepo jīvitindriyassupacchedo,
dn22:18.13: yo kho bhikkhave, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko,
dn22:18.16: yo kho bhikkhave, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ,
dn22:18.19: yaṃ kho bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ,
dn22:18.22: yaṃ kho bhikkhave, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ,
dn22:18.25: yo kho bhikkhave, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ,
dn22:18.27: katamo ca bhikkhave, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho:
dn22:18.28: idha yassa te honti aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā, ye vā panassa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukakāmā ayogakkhemakāmā, yā tehi saddhiṃ saṅgati samāgamo samodhānaṃ missībhāvo,
dn22:18.29: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho.
dn22:18.30: katamo ca bhikkhave, piyehi vippayogo dukkho:
dn22:18.31: idha yassa te honti iṭṭhā kantā manāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā, ye vā panassa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukakāmā yogakkhemakāmā mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā jeṭṭhā vā kaniṭṭhā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā, yā tehi saddhiṃ asaṅgati asamāgamo asamodhānaṃ amissībhāvo,
dn22:18.32: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, piyehi vippayogo dukkho.
dn22:18.33: katamañca bhikkhave, yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ:
dn22:18.34: jātidhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati:
dn22:18.35: aho vata mayaṃ na jātidhammā assāma, na ca vata no jāti āgaccheyyā ti,
dn22:18.37: idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ.
dn22:18.38: jarā dhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati:
dn22:18.39: aho vata mayaṃ na jarādhammā assāma, na ca vata no jarā āgaccheyyā ti,
dn22:18.40: na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ.
dn22:18.41: byādhidhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na byādhidhammā assāma, na ca vata no byādhi āgaccheyyāti,
dn22:18.42: na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ.
dn22:18.43: maraṇadhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na maraṇadhammā assāma, na ca vata no maraṇaṃ āgaccheyyā’ti,
dn22:18.44: na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ.
dn22:18.45: sokadhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na sokadhammā assāma, na ca vata no soko āgaccheyyāti, na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. paridevadhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na paridevadhammā assāma, na ca vata no paridevo āgaccheyyāti, na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. dukkhadhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na dukkhadhammā assāma, na ca vata no dukkhaṃ āgaccheyyāti, na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. domanassadhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na domanassadhammā assāma, na ca vata no domanassaṃ āgaccheyyāti, na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ. idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. upāyāsadhammānaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati: aho vata mayaṃ na upāyāsadhammā assāma, na ca vata no upāyāso āgaccheyyāti,
dn22:18.47: idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ.
dn22:18.48: katame ca bhikkhave, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā:
dn22:18.49: seyyathidaṃ rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṅkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇupādānakkhandho.
dn22:18.50: ime vuccanti bhikkhave, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā.

dn22:21.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
dn22:21.5: yaṃ kho bhikkhave, dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyāpaṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ.
dn22:21.11: musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī.
dn22:21.14: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī.
dn22:21.17: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako micchāājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti.
dn22:21.20: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.21: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti, padahati.
dn22:21.22: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.23: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
dn22:21.26: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn22:21.27: vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn22:21.28: citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
dn22:21.29: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn22:21.32: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
dn22:21.33: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn22:21.34: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati, sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti, taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
dn22:21.35: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn22:21.37: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
dn22:21.38: iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati.
dn22:21.39: samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati.
dn22:21.40: atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya patissatimattāya. anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
dn22:21.41: evampi kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catusu ariyasaccesu.
